spec.name: Furniture Witch Potion Display
spec.description: A low wooden apothecary tray with three squat corked bottles in poison green, violet and amber, plus a tiny ivory skull. Hand-painted survival furniture with no labels; front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tabletop wooden apothecary tray holding three squat corked potion bottles in poison green, violet and amber, with a tiny clean ivory skull; no text labels. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
